requires_external_validation.scope: Externally review scalar closure,finite-mark identities,Laguerre envelope and imported factory implementation; implement an outward-certified quantized/observation-law output with charged expected bit costs. Compare matched exact/approximate outputs against strongest moment/spectral/time-relaxed methods including initial-law acquisition and transient-detection precision. A consequential extension needs a new closure/envelope for spatial,anisotropic,velocity-dependent or reactive dynamics rather than a renamed variance parameter.
